testScenarios.objective: Evaluate customer experience while using Clip Studio Paint with inking, playing with the UI and exporting a file.
testScenarios.detailedSteps:
1. Setup the DUT with the Base OS image, software and firmware required.
2. Download, Install and Launch latest version of Manga Studio (Clip Studio Paint): https://www.clipstudio.net/en
3. Select “PAINT” from the left pane. If there is not a license available, a trial version can be used. Chose “EX” grade.
4. Take the Surface Pen and ink on a new canvas. Make sure that the inking follows the pen as you write on the surface. Use different pencils and Brush size from the left pane.
5. Try different Workspaces (Windows menu → Workspace → (comic, illustration, By Category)).
6. Create different layers using the menu Layer.
7. Make sure there are not any visual anomalies while using the app and/or pen that negatively might impact the customer experience.
8. Export file as a TIFF file (Menu File → Export (single Layer) → .tif )
Note: If a license is not available, you won’t be able to export files.
9. View in Windows Photo viewer as well as Photos. There shouldn’t be any problem to see the exported file.
testScenarios.passFailCriteria: The test will pass if the following conditions are not seen: a) There are any visual anomalies or other issues that negatively impact the customer experience.

testScenarios.objective: Evaluate customer experience with Fresco workflows and animations.
testScenarios.detailedSteps:
1.  Install Adobe Creative Suite and launch Fresco. (https://www.adobe.com/)  
a. “Start a new document” select document size (Square) 
3.  Select different brushes, brush sizes and colors and draw on background (Pixel layer) [hover over layers on center right if looking for correct layer]  
4.  After drawing background, center right hand side you will see a “ + “ plus sign, this will add a new layer to your picture. Click this ‘plus’ and draw a short line or ‘dash’ (ensure that this new layer is highlighted/active).  
5.  Look at 2 icons in bottom right corner, we will be using the 3 bubble looking icon for ‘animation’ [when you first click on this icon, it will offer tutorial if interested, click <ok> to bypass]  
a. In center bottom of picture, you will now have a couple of new menu items, on the upper menu, you should see a miniature of your latest layer with a 1/1 and a “ + “ plus sign, click the ‘plus’.  
b. This will hide the background and give you a blank sheet. For now, draw a short line or ‘dash’ mark. You will alternate, clicking ‘plus’ and drawing a short ‘dash’ mark.  
Try to continue placing the dash where the previous dash ended.  
c. Continue until you roughly complete a circle   
d. On the menu below (bottom center) you will see a ‘play all / pause’, ‘Path’, and ‘Settings’, click on ‘Play all’ and ensure that Fresco plays through all your layers.   
6.  Select ‘Vector brushs (V)’ on left top tool and draw a geometric shape (triangle, square); locate the ‘touch shortcut’ this will be a white/gray circle to (if default) lower left of screen. 
a. Double tap on ‘touch shortcut’ (center will turn blue) now when you draw using ‘vector brush’ it will erase the lines you previously drew. 
b. Double click on blue dot in center to unselect ‘touch shortcut’, and ensure that you can draw again using ‘vector brush’. 
7.   Next well export picture as an .Mp4 and verify it is viewable. 
a.  Look along top right tool bar and to the left of the gear is a box with an arrow pointing up ( if you hover over with mouse, you will get toast saying 'share'). Click on this icon. 
b.  Select 'Publish & Export Social media, and other formats'. 
c.   Select 'Motion'. 
d.  Select 'Generate frames' ( Format should be 'MP4', and 'Automatic'). 
e.  Bottom right, select 'Export', select 'Desktop' and <Save>. 
f.  Play freshly generated <filename>.MP4 in 'Movies & TV' app and verify animation works, picture is viewable and issue doesn't hit any issues described in Pass/Fail Criteria.
testScenarios.passFailCriteria: The test will pass if the following conditions are not seen: a) There are any visual anomalies or other issues that negatively impact the customer experience.

testScenarios.objective: Evaluate customer experience with animating a video sequence in Adobe.
testScenarios.detailedSteps:
1. Install Adobe Creative Suite and launch After Effects. (https://www.adobe.com/) 
2. Copy the folder “Project_AfterEffects” to the DUT from this location: \desmo\wds\PLE\Creativity\Tools\Project_AfterEffects Note: For external partners, please see your local share folder with a similar location: \Creativity\Tools\Project_AfterEffects. 
3. Choose New Project and then go to File menu → Import → Files and select the location where Project_AfterEffects folder was copied locally. Import all the files. 
4. Drag and drop 1_UFO.mov file to the "Timeline" panel. 
5. Drag and drop 2_Corn Moon_CC.mp4 file below the 1_UFO.mov file. 
6. Drag and drop 3_Background 4K.mp4 file below the 2_Corn Moon_CC.mp4 file. 
7. Drag and drop 4_UFO Audio.wav file below the 3_Background 4K.mp4 file. 
8. In the left section of the "Timeline" panel, click the 2_Corn Moon_CC.mp4 file. 
9. In the "Composition" panel, drag and drop the "moon" object to the upper left-hand corner of the video. 
10. Press the Spacebar key to play the entire video sequences. Make sure that the entire video sequences (video and audio) play without issues from start to finish. 
11. Press the Spacebar key again to pause the video. 
12. In the left section of the "Timeline" panel, click the 1_UFO.mov file. 
13. In the "Composition" panel, drag and drop the "UFO" object a quarter of the way right. 
14. Press the Spacebar key again to continue the video sequences. Make sure that the "UFO" object trajectory has now changed.

testScenarios.objective: Evaluate customer experience with editing several clips and exporting them to H264 format in Adobe.
testScenarios.detailedSteps:
1. Install Adobe Creative Suite and launch Premier Pro (https://www.adobe.com/) 
2. Copy the folder “Project_PremierPro” to the DUT from this location: \desmo\wds\PLE\Creativity\Tools\Project_PremierePro Note: For external partners, please see your local share folder with a similar location: .\Creativity\Tools\Project_PremierPro. 
3. Choose New Project and then go to File menu → Import → Files and select the location where Project_PremierPro folder was copied locally. Import all the files. 
4. In the "Project" panel, drag and drop 1_H264_8bit file to the "Timeline" panel. 
5. In the "Project" panel, drag and drop 2_4K-Taipei file to the "Timeline" panel overlapping the 1_H264_8bit file at the 16sec. mark. 
6. In the "Project" panel, drag and drop 3_StepYou.mp3 to the "Timeline" panel under the files of 1_H264_8bit and 2_4K-Taipei 
7. At the top Toolbar, select Effects 
8. In the "Effects" panel, click Video Transitions → Page Peel → Page Turn 
9. Drag and drop the Page Turn effect to the very beginning of 1_H264_8bit sequence (in the "Timeline" panel). 
10. In the "Effects" panel, click Video Transitions → Dissolve → Dip to White 
11. Drag and drop the Dip to White effect to the very beginning of 2_4K-Taipei sequence (in the "Timeline" panel). 
12. Press the Spacebar key to play sequences. (You may stop video after 1min.) 
13. Make sure that the following conditions occur without issues: 
a. At the start of 1_H264_8bit sequence, the Page Turn effect is seen. 
b. At the start of 2_4K-Taipei sequence, the Dip to White effect is seen. 
c. Embedded audio for both videos is heard. 
d. The added 3_StepYou audio is heard throughout the video sequences. 
14. Export the video with matching bitrate and H264 format. (File → Export → Media. Choose H264 format). 
15. View changes in exported file using Movies & TV and Photos. Note: The file generated is saved on ..\Documents\Adobe\Premier Pro\<version>

testScenarios.objective: Evaluate customer experience with importing and exporting 4K videos.
testScenarios.detailedSteps:
1. Download and Install Handbrake (https://handbrake.fr/) 
2. Using a smartphone with support for 4K videos, take a short video (4K) and import the video to the DUT. 
3. Open the file in Handbrake (you can drag it) 
Note: You can use other 4K videos if already have them. 
4. Make sure the video imported is 4K. Go to “Dimensions” tab and check that Source is at least 3840x2160. 
5. Export the video using a standard 720p template from the presets. Go to “Presets” menu → Presets → General → Very Fast 720p30. 
6. Set the destination path for the output file by clicking on Browse button and defining a name. 
7. Press “Start Encoding”. Wait for encoding to finish. 
8. Playback file in default application detected by the OS to see if encoding was successful.
testScenarios.passFailCriteria: The test will pass if the following conditions are not seen: a) There are any visual and/or Audio anomalies or other issues that negatively impact the customer experience.
